title: Stanley station (North Dakota)
extracted_sentences: Stanley station is a train station in Stanley, North Dakota served by Amtrak's Empire Builder line.
The platform, tracks, and wooden depot are owned by BNSF Railway.
It was originally a Great Northern Railway station that was a replacement for an earlier one, which is now a private residence .
